---
title: "revealjs: aside at the slide bottom"
format: revealjs
# The aside is the last child of its slide section, and the classes the
# stylesheet keys on (`scrollable`, `center`) reach the section. Where the
# aside lands is CSS: `quarto-reveal.css` makes leaf slides full height so
# `bottom: 20px` is the slide bottom. Those rules are asserted in
# crates/quarto-core/tests/integration/revealjs_features.rs and were measured
# in a browser against Quarto 1.
_quarto:
  tests:
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - - 'section#plain > aside.aside:last-child'
          - 'section#scrolls.scrollable > aside.aside:last-child'
          - 'section#middle.center > aside.aside:last-child'
          - 'section > section#child > aside.aside:last-child'
        - []
---
